el-chalten.overview: El Chaltén is Argentina's hiking capital, with trails that lead straight from town into the jagged peaks of the Andes. The standouts are the long trek to Laguna de los Tres, with a steep final climb, for a close-up of Mount Fitz Roy, and the easier valley walk to Laguna Torre beneath Cerro Torre. For multi-day hikers, the demanding Huemul Circuit, about 40 miles in four days, crosses high passes and skirts the Southern Patagonian Ice Field. October to April is the prime window, though the granite spires can hide behind clouds even on clear days.
